attempts.summary: Set up a cron-driven pull-sync on node2 that fetches /etc/inventory/app.conf from node1 (source of truth) every 5 minutes via passwordless SSH (cluster keypair) and applies it only when changed. Verified two independent live updates on node1 propagated to node2 automatically within a cron cycle, and confirmed the mechanism survives a reboot of both nodes (new boot IDs observed, cron/ssh services and synced data all recovered).
